sources.evidence: Turk's Head Brewery's current official home page states that it is the Turks & Caicos Islands' locally brewed beer, that it currently brews five core beer types (Lager, Light Lager, Amber Ale, IPA and Stout), offers brewery tours explaining how its beer is made, and lists the brewery at 52 Universal Drive, Providenciales.

The current official sustainability page states that Turk's Head Brewery operates as part of Provo Beverages, describes fermentation at the brewery, and states that recovered CO2 is reused to carbonate its beers and ready-to-drink products; it also lists the same brewery address in Providenciales.
